description: The pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)” depicts how tokens are distributed across routing categories in FedHLM and contains three slices: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. LOCAL is shown as a large green slice labeled 94.5%, EDGE_P2P appears as a small blue slice labeled 1.6%, and LLM appears as a small red slice labeled 3.9%. Percentage values are printed inside the slices, and the category names are placed near the corresponding wedges; there is no separate legend visible. No slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slices visually appear arranged with the largest (LOCAL) dominating most of the circle and the two smaller slices grouped together.
caption_used: Token Routing Distribution for FedHLM: The pie chart illustrates the proportion of tokens routed across three categories: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The LOCAL category dominates with approximately 94.5% of the distribution, while EDGE_P2P and LLM account for roughly 5.5% and 2.5%, respectively. Notably, the EDGE_P2P category has shown a steady increase in its share compared to previous analyses, surpassing LLM in token routing. The chart provides a clear visual representation of these proportions, with percentage labels inside each slice for clarity.
